name: BOSTON UK
description:
BOSTON STUMP - BOSTON UK Official Collectible Coin

This is NOT Boston, USA. This is the ORIGINAL Boston - Boston, Lincolnshire, England, UK.

Standing tall since 1309, St Botolph's Church, known worldwide as 'The Boston Stump', is one of the largest parish churches in England. Its incredible 272ft tower has guided travellers across the flat Lincolnshire Fens for over 700 years and can be seen for miles. This is where it all began.

The Link That Made History:
In 1630, a group of Puritan pilgrims led by Reverend John Cotton sailed from THIS Boston to create a new town in Massachusetts. They named it Boston, after their home town. So the world-famous American Boston is literally named after our Boston in Lincolnshire. Without Boston UK, there would be no Boston USA. Two Bostons, one incredible shared history.

Why This Coin Is An Investment:
This is the first ever premium 3D Boston Stump coin to be released. Boston UK coins have NEVER been done properly before, and with Boston, Massachusetts celebrating its 400th anniversary soon, interest in the ORIGINAL Boston is exploding worldwide.

Early holders of historic town coins always profit most. This is a low supply, high demand heritage piece for collectors in both the UK and the USA. Hold it, and you hold 700 years of history that connects two nations. As awareness grows, value grows.

This is Boston. The Original. Boston UK.

Invest in history. Invest in The Stump.
